name: calculation_engine
description: Perform a financial calculation and show the intermediate steps. ALWAYS use this instead of doing arithmetic yourself. Types and inputs: growth_rate/percent_change (current, previous); cagr (begin_value, end_value, years); margin (numerator, revenue); ratio (numerator, denominator); dcf (cash_flows[], discount_rate, terminal_growth_rate, optional net_debt, shares_outstanding); descriptive_stats (values[]). Rates are fractions: 0.1 = 10%.

inputs.description: Named numeric inputs for the chosen calculation type (see the tool description).
